title: 1920s Craftsman Convenient Charm
description:
Allow us to welcome you to locals’ favorite neighborhood of East Nashville.  Bypass the daily congestion of downtown crowds, while remaining a short 10min drive to Broadway bars & Germantown. 

Within a 5 min walk, you can find yourself in a beer garden,  tiki bar, cafe, taco spot & much more.  

Recently reovated to include multiple work-from-home spaces, a fully stocked kitchen, a relaxing media room with a 75”tv, and other thoughtful additions.  Fully fenced in backyard for your pup.
